intents.name: order_status
intents.description: asks where the order is / its status / ETA / tracking, with no complaint
intents.not_this: a plain question about where the order is; if the customer complains it is late, use delivery_delay
examples: my app says confirmed, what does that mean for delivery
I placed an order 20 minutes ago, any update?
has my order left the restaurant yet
track my order
where's my food
order status please
tracking link not showing, where is my order
order kahan hai mera
what is the current status of my delivery
has the rider been assigned yet
is my food on the way
when will the rider pick up my order
can I get an eta for my order

intents.name: delivery_delay
intents.description: complains the order is late or delayed
intents.not_this: a complaint that it is late; if they only ask where it is, use order_status; if cancelling is the first ask, use cancel_order
examples: you are late and the rider isn't picking up my calls
you promised 30 minutes, it's been 75
why is it delayed so much
rider has been stuck at the same place for 20 minutes
delivery late, I am really hungry
the delivery time keeps increasing
eta was 7 pm and it's 8 now
the order was supposed to be here already

intents.name: cancel_order
intents.description: wants to cancel an order that is not yet delivered
intents.not_this: cancel before delivery; for an already delivered order use refund_request (rule 3)
examples: cancel my order before it is prepared
cancel it please
cancel the order I made 5 minutes ago
I accidentally ordered, please cancel
I'd like to cancel this order and reorder
cancel the grocery order I just placed
I want to cancel my order
can you cancel the order, I changed my mind
cancel my food order, taking too long

intents.name: refund_request
intents.description: wants money back / refund status / compensation for an order (delivered or already paid)
intents.not_this: money back for a delivered or paid order; for a failed payment use payment_failed
examples: refund the amount for the late order
can I get a refund for the damaged groceries
refund credited? I don't see it
my refund is stuck
the food was inedible, I want a refund
please process my refund
I want compensation and a refund for this order
initiate a refund for my order
order was delivered cold, refund please

intents.name: missing_item
intents.description: an item or part of the order is absent / not received
intents.not_this: something absent from the bag; if a different item arrived use wrong_item
examples: I did not receive my fries
half my groceries are missing
my order is incomplete
the delivery had only the main course, no sides
I ordered 3 things but only got 2
bag mein ek item nahi hai
the bag was missing the sauce packets
an item is missing from my order

intents.name: wrong_item
intents.description: received something different from what was ordered (wrong or someone else's order)
intents.not_this: something different arrived; if something is absent use missing_item
examples: this is the wrong order, please fix it
I asked for veg and got non-veg
someone else's food came to me
I received the wrong item
they delivered the wrong dish
the order I received belongs to another customer

intents.name: payment_failed
intents.description: a payment failed, was declined, deducted twice, or money was taken without an order
intents.not_this: the payment itself failed or was duplicated; asking for the money back after delivery is refund_request
examples: upi payment stuck on processing
money got deducted but the order was not placed
paisa kat gaya par order nahi hua
payment gateway error
card declined at checkout
I paid but it shows unpaid
transaction failed, what do I do

intents.name: promo_code_issue
intents.description: a coupon / promo code / discount does not work or was not applied
intents.not_this: coupon / discount / offer problems; cashback or refunds of money are refund_request
examples: my coupon code is not working
the discount was not applied to my order
promo code says invalid or expired
where do I enter my promo code
free delivery offer is not showing in the final amount
promo kaam nahi kar raha
I applied a coupon but the total did not change
my first order discount is missing

intents.name: change_address
intents.description: wants to change or fix the delivery address
intents.not_this: delivery address only; phone number, name or profile edits are account_help
examples: change the address on my account
address change please
need to edit my delivery location
address galat dal diya, change karo
please redirect my order to another address
can you deliver to a different address
I want it sent to my friend's place instead

intents.name: account_help
intents.description: login, password, OTP, profile, phone/email, delete account or other account problems
intents.not_this: login, password, OTP, profile or saved-card problems; address changes are change_address
examples: I forgot my password
otp is not coming for login
how do I delete my account
my account has been locked
update my phone number on my profile
the app keeps logging me out
my saved cards are missing from my account
mera password reset nahi ho raha

intents.name: talk_to_agent
intents.description: asks ONLY for a human agent / escalation, with no other request
intents.not_this: ONLY a request for a human; if another request is present, that request wins (rule 5)
examples: talk to executive
I'd like to speak with a supervisor
customer care number do
I want to escalate this to a person
customer service please
someone from your team should call me
put me through to a human agent
insaan se baat karni hai

intents.name: out_of_scope
intents.description: anything not about QuickCart orders, accounts or payments (small talk, gibberish, other companies, services QuickCart does not offer such as gift cards, loyalty points, tax invoices, tipping riders, restaurant feedback); a greeting or thanks alone
intents.not_this: not about QuickCart orders, accounts or payments; greeting or thanks alone (rule 6)
examples: translate hello to french
where can I buy a laptop
how do I book a flight
what are the best restaurants in the city
my car won't start
what is the capital of France
I want to book a hotel
thanks
who is the prime minister
what is 15 times 12
which phone should I buy
good morning
tell me a joke
can you help me with my homework
